text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Hokko 
Tarumae. She asked if I could keep her 
company a little longer, and when I 
decided to follow her—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san, I'm looking forward to 
working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it all to me! Let's get fired 
up and go all out!
choice_data_list: Um, where are you headed now...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Of course, it has to be the mountains~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Seiya! Soiya!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: H-Heeeyaaah...! Soooyaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san, your voice lacks power! These 
are warm-ups for our training, so let me 
hear you—
choice_data_list: Um, what on earth are you about to do...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We are indulging in some training. I am 
assisting Tarumae-san in overcoming her 
seasickness.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The other day in class, I was talking 
about how easily I get seasick. 
Kawakami-san overheard and offered to help 
me overcome it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training overcomes 
seasickness, exactly...? I'm not quite 
sure, but I decide to keep an eye on the 
two of them for now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, faster and smoother! Become one in 
spirit with the suspension bridge!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Taaah...?! Hyaaah! W-Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You have completed the "Wobbly Suspension 
Bridge High-Speed Dash" splendidly! Now 
then, onto the next training—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Um, Kawakami-san, quick 
question—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san, I believe you promised to 
address me as "Master" during our 
training.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, r-right... Um... I was just wondering 
if this training regimen really has any 
effect...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Shedding sweat and tearsâ 
that is how PreFy became strong as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san, when your heart falters, 
remember your dream! Once you conquer 
seasickness, what is it that you wish to 
achieve...?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I want to hold a solo show on a 
cruise ship stopping at Tomakomai Port...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hosting a show on a ship to share 
Tomakomai with the world! That was your 
dream, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Then shout that dream with all your 
might! For Tomakomai! Put Tomakomai on the 
world stage!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
For Tomakomai! Tomakomai to the world! For 
Tomakomai! Tomakomai to the world!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm all fired up!! I am 
definitely getting over this seasickness!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! For our next training: 
"100 Dizzy-Bat Dash Repeats"! Please 
follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! Master!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Hokko Tarumae went 
through all sorts of unique special 
training. And then, the stage of our 
training shifted—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san, you have done splendidly to 
endure this grueling training. Now, your 
final trial is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The scariest coaster, "Tornado Hell"!! 
Ride it and shout out your true feelings!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Master! I will overcome this trial 
and complete my training to the very end!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please ride with me!! Please bear 
witness to my training!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... so, so high up...! The people look 
so tiny...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We're dropping...! Tarumae-san, I'm going 
to pour out every last bit of my feelings!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Magnificently!! Gracefully!! Valiantly!! 
Roaring Rampage Princess☆Princess 
Fighter!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Keep Lake Utonai in your heart!! Keep 
haskap berries in your heart!! Love for 
the hometown is eternal and 
indestructible!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The star of Tomakomai! I'm Hokko Tarumae!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san!! Perfect!! Flawlesssss!!! I 
have nothing left to teach youuuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! Yeah, I feel like I 
wouldn't get seasick on any ship right 
now...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's check it out right away!
Don't let your guard down just yet!
Don't let your guard down just yet!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! Yeah, I feel like I 
wouldn't get seasick on any ship right 
now...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's check it out right away!
Don't let your guard down just yet!
Don't let your guard down just yet!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's do that! I'm pretty sure there were 
boats in the park! Let's go ride one right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san, right now you are invincible 
and unmatched!! Board that duck paddle 
boat with full confidence!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Kawakami-san, thanks for everything. 
Well then, here I go...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Twainer... I feel so siiiick...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The road to conquering seasickness still 
seemed very, very long...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ! Y-You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You are absolutely right, Trainer. As 
PriFie said in episode 27: "Only after 
victory should one stand beneath the 
waterfall!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just as you both said, overconfidence is 
our greatest enemy...! So just to be safe, 
let's ride the roller coaster one more 
time for training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Hokko Tarumae rode roller 
coasters non-stop until the park closed.
